dedupe_keys.name: ts satfire a multi task satellite image time series dataset for wildfire detection and prediction

description: TS-SatFire: A Multi-Task Satellite Image Time-Series Dataset for Wildfire Detection and Prediction is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Yu Zhao et al. Wildfire monitoring and prediction help describe wildfire behaviour. With extensive Earth observation data, these tasks can be integrated and enhanced through multi-task deep learning models. We present a multi-temporal remote sensing dataset for active fire detection, daily wildfire monitoring, and next-day wildfire prediction. Covering wildfire events in the contiguous U.S. Coverage: not stated; published in 2025. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The data are held in Kaggle and reached through the repository address listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
